stdout:
Send a live chat message. Use this tool to post a text message to a live chat.

Usage:
  yutu liveChatMessage insert [flags]

Examples:
# Send a message to a live chat
yutu liveChatMessage insert --liveChatId abc123 --messageText "Hello everyone!"

Flags:
  -h, --help                 help for insert
  -l, --liveChatId string    ID of the live chat
  -m, --messageText string   Text of the message to send
  -o, --output string        json|yaml|silent
  -p, --parts strings        Parts to include (default [snippet])
      --yes                  Confirm the operation
